figs.name: controllogix-5590-operating-mode-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: ControlLogix 5590 operating mode flowchart: standard, redundancy, safety and Logix SIS
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to pick one of the four ControlLogix 5590 modes from safety and availability needs: Standard, Redundancy, Safety or Logix SIS.

<rect x="405" y="470" width="185" height="92" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
